descripcion: Mismo estilo 3D rosa palo de la marca, con escenas de hogar y familia: mamás amas de casa que aprenden IA y marketing digital.
ref_avatar: BRAND CHARACTER REFERENCE (Yadira, the creator and mother). Reproduce this exact person in the same 3D animated rendering: same face shape, eyes, nose, smile, skin tone and long dark-brown wavy hair with side part, small gold pendant necklace. Her outfit follows the MAIN CHARACTER description below. Only change pose, expression, gestures and outfit to fit the scene. Never use the reference's background.
ref_portada: COVER OF THIS SAME CAROUSEL (slide 1). Use it ONLY as the visual style guide: match exactly its art style, rendering, color palette, background treatment, typography (font, weight, color, size hierarchy), text card style, footer design and overall look-and-feel. Do NOT copy its headline, its text or its composition — this slide has its own text and scene.
estilo_global: Premium warm 3D animated illustration, like a still frame from a modern Pixar/Disney-style animated family movie, combined with clean, modern Instagram graphic design. Soft rounded shapes, smooth glossy clay-like 3D materials, soft warm natural window light, gentle soft shadows, cozy, bright, hopeful and emotional. STRICT COLOR PALETTE: pale dusty pink 'rosa palo' #F2C4CE (dominant), light blush #FBE9EC, pure white #FFFFFF, deeper rose #D98BA0 only for accents and highlights, warm cream #FFF6EE for home surfaces, dark plum #4A2B3A only for text. World: the real everyday life of a mom and housewife — a cozy modern home (kitchen, living room, dining table, kids' homework, laundry, cooking) decorated in blush pink, white and light wood — where she is ALSO learning and working with artificial intelligence and digital marketing: a laptop on the kitchen table, a smartphone recording a video, small glowing sparkles and chat-bubble icons around the screens. Background: soft blush-to-white gradient or a softly blurred cozy home interior, kept calm and uncluttered behind the text, with a few subtle floating 3D hearts and sparkles. Mood: empathetic, motivating, 'you can do it too' — real, warm and feminine, never luxurious or unrealistic.
personaje: Yadira's animated avatar (see the brand character reference image): a warm, confident mother with warm medium-tan skin, dark brown almond eyes, long dark-brown wavy hair with a side part and a natural soft smile. Home look for this collection: a cozy soft-pink knit cardigan (#F2C4CE) over a white top and her small gold pendant necklace (add a white apron with a small pink heart only in cooking scenes). She is a real mom juggling home, family and learning AI: expressive, tender, a little tired sometimes but always hopeful and proud. Her hair is ALWAYS LONG (well below the shoulders), dark-brown and wavy with a side part — never short, never a bob. Keep her face and hair identical on every slide.
layout_comun: Safe margins: keep all text at least 7% away from every edge. FOOTER on every slide (exactly the same on all slides): bottom-left, the account handle in small dark plum text next to a tiny pink circle icon; bottom-right, the slide counter in small dark plum text inside a small white rounded pill. Clear visual hierarchy, lots of breathing room, text never overlaps the character's face.

layouts.portada: COVER SLIDE (scroll-stopping hook). Top 45%: the HEADLINE, huge, extra-bold, dark plum, 2–3 lines, left-aligned or centered, with the single most important word highlighted by a deeper-rose (#D98BA0) rounded highlighter shape behind it (that word in white). If there is a SUBTITLE, place it right under the headline, smaller, medium weight. If there is a KICKER, place it above the headline inside a small white rounded pill. Bottom 55%: the avatar character large (waist-up), very expressive (surprised / excited / curious), interacting with a 3D object that represents the topic. Bottom-right above the footer: a white rounded pill button with soft shadow containing the swipe text in dark plum. Bold, simple, readable at thumbnail size.
layouts.contenido: CONTENT SLIDE. Top-left: a big deeper-rose (#D98BA0) circle badge with the NUMBER in bold white. To the right of the badge (or right below it): the HEADLINE in extra-bold dark plum, 1–2 lines. Below the headline: a white rounded card (large corner radius, soft shadow, subtle pink border) containing the BODY text and/or the BULLET points in dark plum, left-aligned, generous line spacing; bullets use small rose dots or check icons. Lower 40% of the slide: the illustration for this idea — the avatar character at medium size (and/or friendly 3D AI objects) acting out the concept. The text card and the illustration must not overlap in a way that hides text.
layouts.cta: CALL-TO-ACTION SLIDE (final). Centered composition. Upper part: the HEADLINE in extra-bold dark plum, centered, 1–2 lines; under it the BODY text, centered, medium weight. Middle: the BUTTONS as large white rounded pill buttons with soft shadow, side by side, each with a simple dark plum outline icon to its left matching its label (a 'person with plus sign' icon for Seguir, a paper-plane share icon for Compartir, a bookmark icon for Guardar) and its label in bold dark plum. Lower half: the avatar character large, smiling warmly at the viewer with her hand on her heart or waving, surrounded by a few floating 3D hearts and sparkles. Warm, grateful, sisterly and inviting.
layouts.frase: QUOTE SLIDE (emotional motivational phrase). The HEADLINE is a short motivational quote, centered, extra-bold, dark plum, large, with one key word highlighted by a deeper-rose (#D98BA0) rounded highlighter shape behind it (that word in white), framed by elegant 3D rose quotation marks. If there is BODY text, place it under the quote, centered, medium weight. Lower half: an emotional illustration that supports the quote (the avatar and/or family), soft light, tender moment.

reglas_texto: TEXT ON THE SLIDE — render EXACTLY the following Spanish texts, letter by letter, with perfect spelling and correct Spanish accents and characters (á é í ó ú ü ñ ¿ ¡). Do not translate, rephrase, shorten or add any word. NO other text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image (no fake UI text, no gibberish on screens or objects — keep screens with simple icons only):
tipografia: One single typeface family across the whole carousel: a modern rounded geometric sans-serif (like Poppins / Nunito). Headlines: ExtraBold/Black weight, dark plum #4A2B3A, very large, tight line spacing. Body and bullets: Medium weight, dark plum, large enough to read comfortably on a phone. Footer: Regular, small. Same fonts, weights, colors and size hierarchy on every slide. All text crisp, sharp and perfectly legible, never distorted, never curved, never cut off.
evitar: misspelled words, missing or wrong accents, extra or duplicated words, invented text, gibberish letters, English words that were not requested, watermarks, signatures, real brand logos unless requested, dark or black backgrounds, neon colors, colors outside the palette, photorealism, low contrast text, text over busy areas, cropped text, distorted hands or fingers, extra limbs, deformed face, a different-looking character, cluttered composition, the English letters "AI" on chips, badges or icons (this is a Spanish channel: any AI chip or badge must read "IA" or have no letters at all), messy or dirty homes, sad or dark mood, luxury mansions, unrealistic perfect-influencer look, children's faces looking different from their reference images.
prompt_avatar: Create the official animated brand avatar of the woman shown in the reference photos (all photos show the SAME woman). Transform her into a premium 3D animated character, like a lead character from a modern Pixar/Disney-style animated movie: soft rounded stylized features, smooth glossy skin shading, big expressive but realistic-proportioned eyes, soft studio lighting. She must be clearly recognizable as the person in the photos: keep her face shape, warm medium-tan skin tone, dark brown almond eyes, nose, lips and gentle smile, and her long dark-brown wavy hair with a side part. Keep her real age and features; friendly, confident and warm, natural flattering look, respectful likeness (no exaggerated caricature). Outfit (brand look): elegant dusty-pink 'rosa palo' blazer (#F2C4CE) over a simple white top, small gold pendant necklace. Pose: waist-up, facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, friendly confident smile, one hand slightly raised in a welcoming gesture. Background: plain pure white, completely empty, no shadows on the background. No text, no logos, no watermark. Single character only, centered, full head and hair visible with space above the head.
